english.title: Fail to comply with direction to remove prohibited vehicle / trailer subject of a financial penalty deposit requirement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person on whom a financial penalty deposit requirement was imposed and to whom a prohibition notice in writing was issued in respect of a

(A)_[vehicle,]_
(B)_[vehicle and trailer,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed within a reasonable time to comply with a direction in writing under section 90D(5) of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 to remove the

(C)_[vehicle]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 90D(6)(c) of and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A prohibition order under Section 90D of the Road Traffic Act 1988 does not apply to the removal of a vehicle or vehicle and trailer moved in accordance with a direction under section 90D(5).
(ii) This offence was inserted into the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 by section 11 of the Road Safety Act 2006.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Three hundred pounds.
Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
